title: THE ODYSSEY
source: Group Adaptation Project Group D — Script

scenes.title: ITHACA · PROLOGUE
script: PROLOGUE — ITHACA
Opening Cutscene
[BLACK SCREEN]
The sound of waves can be heard.
TEXT ON SCREEN:
Ten years have passed since the Greeks sailed to Troy.
Troy has fallen.
But not every warrior has returned home.
[FADE IN: ITHACA — ODYSSEUS' PALACE]
The camera moves across the island of Ithaca before approaching Odysseus' palace. Inside, dozens of suitors eat, drink, and argue loudly. Servants carry food and wine to them.
At the edge of the room stands TELEMACHUS, watching them.

SUITOR 1:
More wine!

SUITOR 2:
And tell Penelope she cannot hide upstairs forever.
The suitors laugh.
Telemachus clenches his fist.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — TELEMACHUS
MAIN QUEST: THE ABSENT KING
Objective: Speak with Penelope.
The player can explore a small section of the palace before continuing upstairs.
Optional Side Quest — Unwanted Guests
Objective: Speak to three suitors.
Talking to them gives the player more information about what has happened during Odysseus' absence.

SUITOR:
Twenty years, boy. Ten fighting at Troy and nearly ten more without a word. How long do you expect Ithaca to wait for a dead king?
Penelope's Room
Telemachus enters.
Penelope sits beside her loom, working on the burial shroud she has promised to finish before choosing a new husband.

TELEMACHUS:
They're getting worse.

PENELOPE:
I know.

TELEMACHUS:
Then choose one of them. Or send them away.

PENELOPE:
This is your father's house. They will not listen to me.
Telemachus looks toward the sea through the window.

TELEMACHUS:
And if he's dead?
Penelope stops weaving.

PENELOPE:
Then someone should bring me proof.

TELEMACHUS:
And if he's alive?

PENELOPE:
Then he is trying to come home.
[CUTSCENE]
The camera moves through the window and across the sea.
The waves become louder.
The screen fades to black.
TEXT ON SCREEN:
Far across the sea, the war at Troy has finally ended.
A distant city burns.
And Odysseus, King of Ithaca, begins his journey home.
TITLE CARD:
THE ODYSSEY

scenes.title: TROY
objectives: Speak with three members of your crew.

side.name: Echoes of Troy
side.objective: Speak to surviving Greek soldiers before departing.

script: LOCATION 1 — TROY
Troy — After the War
[CUTSCENE]
The player sees the aftermath of the Trojan War. Smoke rises from Troy while Greek soldiers prepare their ships along the shore.
Odysseus stands overlooking the sea.
Behind him are 12 ships, each carrying approximately 50 men.
A soldier approaches.

EURYLOCHUS:
The ships are ready.

ODYSSEUS:
And the men?

EURYLOCHUS:
Tired. But alive.
Odysseus looks back at Troy.

ODYSSEUS:
That's more than many can say.

EURYLOCHUS:
Where to now?
Odysseus looks across the water.

ODYSSEUS:
Ithaca.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE JOURNEY HOME

Objective 1: Walk through the Greek camp.
Objective 2: Speak with three members of your crew.
Objective 3: Board your ship.
The player can explore the shoreline and speak to soldiers about the Trojan War.
Optional Side Quest — Echoes of Troy
Objective: Speak to surviving Greek soldiers before departing.
These conversations provide background about the Trojan War, Odysseus' role in it, and how long the Greeks have been away from home.

SOLDIER:
Ten years for one city.

ODYSSEUS:
Ten years too many.

SOLDIER:
Do you think Ithaca will look the same?
Dialogue Choice:

A: "I know my home."
B: "Twenty years changes a kingdom."
C: "It doesn't matter. I'm going back."
The choice does not change the main story, but different crew members may remember Odysseus' response later.
Departure Cutscene
Odysseus walks onto his ship.
The sails rise.

ODYSSEUS:
Men of Ithaca!
The crew turns toward him.

ODYSSEUS:
We crossed this sea as soldiers. We cross it again as survivors. Our war is finished.
The men cheer.

ODYSSEUS:
Set a course for home!
QUEST COMPLETE: THE JOURNEY HOME
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: ISMAROS

scenes.title: ISMAROS: LAND OF THE CICONES
objectives: Order your men back to the ships.

side.name: Spoils of War
side.objective: Discover an extra part of the story.

script: LOCATION 2 — ISMAROS: LAND OF THE CICONES
Arrival
[CUTSCENE]
Odysseus' fleet approaches the coastal city of Ismaros, home of the Cicones.

CREWMAN:
Captain! Land ahead!
Odysseus walks to the front of the ship.

EURYLOCHUS:
Cicones.

ODYSSEUS:
They fought beside Troy.
The crew reaches for their weapons.

ODYSSEUS:
Prepare to land.
MAIN QUEST: THE RAID OF ISMAROS
Objective: Raid the Cicones' city.
The player fights alongside Odysseus' crew as they attack Ismaros. After the battle, the Greeks take supplies, food, treasure, and livestock.
Eventually, the fighting stops.
Odysseus looks toward the mountains.
Something feels wrong.

ODYSSEUS:
We've taken enough.

EURYLOCHUS:
The city is ours.

ODYSSEUS:
For now.
NEW OBJECTIVE: Order your men back to the ships.
Odysseus approaches groups of celebrating soldiers.

ODYSSEUS:
Back to the ships. Now.

CREWMAN:
We just won!

ODYSSEUS:
Which is exactly why we leave before they return with reinforcements.

CREWMAN:
We have food. Wine. Treasure. Let the men enjoy one night.
Dialogue Choice:

A: "That's an order."
B: "Every hour we stay puts us in danger."
C: "Fine. But we leave before sunrise."
Regardless of the player's choice, many of the crew refuse to leave immediately.
OBJECTIVE FAILED: RETURN TO THE SHIPS
WARNING: Your crew ignored your command.
Optional Side Quest — Spoils of War
Before the counterattack, the player can search the captured settlement for supplies.
Finding extra food or equipment gives the player resources, but spending too much time exploring triggers increasingly urgent warnings.
WARNING: Enemy forces approaching.
WARNING: Enemy forces approaching.
WARNING: Cicones reinforcements have arrived.
The Counterattack
A horn sounds from the hills.
The celebrating Greeks stop.
Hundreds of Cicones appear in the distance.

EURYLOCHUS:
Odysseus...

ODYSSEUS:
I know.
Odysseus draws his sword.

ODYSSEUS:
FORM RANKS!
MAIN QUEST UPDATED: ESCAPE ISMAROS

Objective 1: Defend the beach.
Objective 2: Reach your ship.
Objective 3: Protect retreating crew members.
Objective 4: Set sail.
The player fights through the counterattack while trying to get the surviving crew onto the ships.
Eventually, Odysseus reaches his vessel.

ODYSSEUS:
Push off!

CREWMAN:
Not everyone's aboard!
Odysseus looks back toward the shore.

ODYSSEUS:
If we stay, no one leaves.
The ships pull away.
Aftermath Cutscene
The sounds of battle disappear as the fleet moves out to sea.
Nobody celebrates.
Odysseus walks among his remaining men.

EURYLOCHUS:
Seventy-two dead.
Odysseus says nothing.

EURYLOCHUS:
Six men from every ship.
Odysseus looks back toward Ismaros.

ODYSSEUS:
We should have left when we had the chance.
QUEST COMPLETE: ESCAPE ISMAROS
CREW LOST: 72
LESSON UNLOCKED: A leader's wisdom means little when others refuse to listen.

script: LOCATION 3 — THE OPEN SEA
Several Days Later
[CUTSCENE]
The ships sail across calm water.
Odysseus stands at the bow.

CREWMAN:
If the winds hold, how long until Ithaca?

ODYSSEUS:
Not long.
For the first time since Troy, Odysseus smiles.
Dark clouds slowly appear on the horizon.
The wind begins to change.

EURYLOCHUS:
Odysseus...
Odysseus turns.
The clouds are moving rapidly toward them.

ODYSSEUS:
Lower the sails!
Thunder crashes.
MAIN QUEST: WRATH OF THE SEA
Objective: Keep the fleet together during the storm.
The player must move around the ship completing objectives as the storm becomes stronger.
OBJECTIVE: Secure the sail.
OBJECTIVE: Help injured crew members.
OBJECTIVE: Keep the ship pointed into the waves.
OBJECTIVE: Signal the other ships.
Rain fills the screen as enormous waves separate the fleet.

CREWMAN:
I CAN'T SEE THE OTHER SHIPS!

ODYSSEUS:
KEEP ROWING!

CREWMAN:
WHICH DIRECTION?
Odysseus looks around. The stars are hidden by the storm.
For once, he has no answer.

ODYSSEUS:
Forward!
Optional Side Quest — The Fallen
After the storm weakens, Odysseus can speak to members of his crew about the men who died at Ismaros.
This side quest gives the player additional information about Odysseus' relationship with his crew and shows the consequences of the previous level.

CREWMAN:
You warned us.

ODYSSEUS:
I commanded you.

CREWMAN:
And we didn't listen.

ODYSSEUS:
Seventy-two men paid for it.
Lost at Sea
[CUTSCENE]
The storm finally disappears.
Morning arrives.
The surviving ships drift across unfamiliar water.

EURYLOCHUS:
Where are we?
Odysseus studies the horizon.

ODYSSEUS:
Not where we're supposed to be.

EURYLOCHUS:
Can you get us back?
Odysseus looks toward the sun.

ODYSSEUS:
Give me time.
A crewman suddenly points toward the horizon.

CREWMAN:
LAND!
The exhausted crew rushes toward the side of the ship.
In the distance is a green island.

EURYLOCHUS:
Do you recognize it?

ODYSSEUS:
No.

EURYLOCHUS:
Then maybe we shouldn't stop.
Odysseus looks at his exhausted men.

ODYSSEUS:
We need food. Fresh water. And rest.

EURYLOCHUS:
And if the people there aren't friendly?
Odysseus watches the island grow closer.

ODYSSEUS:
Then we'll find out soon enough.
QUEST COMPLETE: WRATH OF THE SEA
NEW LOCATION DISCOVERED

scenes.title: THE LAND OF THE LOTUS-EATERS
objectives: Select three men to investigate the island.

side.name: Memories of Ithaca
side.objective: Speak to three crew members about their homes.

script: LOCATION 4 — THE LAND OF THE LOTUS-EATERS
Arrival at the Island
[CUTSCENE]
After nine days of being driven off course by the storm, Odysseus and his fleet finally approach an unfamiliar island.
The sea is calm, and the island is covered in lush greenery. Along the shore, strange flowers grow in abundance.
CREWMAN: Land! Finally!
EURYLOCHUS: We should stop here. The men need food and water.
ODYSSEUS: Agreed. But we don't know who lives here. We must be careful.
The ships approach the shore.
ODYSSEUS: We'll rest here, but not for long. I want everyone ready to sail as soon as we've gathered supplies.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE FORGOTTEN HOME
Objective 1: Explore the shoreline. Objective 2: Speak with your crew. Objective 3: Select three men to investigate the island.
The player can explore the beach and interact with crew members preparing supplies.
Optional Side Quest — Memories of Ithaca
Objective: Speak to three crew members about their homes.
These conversations provide additional information about the lives Odysseus' men left behind and emphasize the importance of returning home.
CREWMAN: I wonder if my family will even recognize me.
ODYSSEUS: They will.
CREWMAN: It's been twenty years since we left Ithaca.
ODYSSEUS: Then we've kept them waiting long enough.
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: MEMORIES OF ITHACA
The Lotus-Eaters
[CUTSCENE]
Odysseus sends three men to explore the island and discover who lives there.
ODYSSEUS: Find out who inhabits this place. See if they have food or water to spare, but do not provoke anyone.
SCOUT: Understood, Captain.
The three men disappear into the forest.
The camera follows them as they encounter the Lotus-Eaters, peaceful inhabitants of the island.
LOTUS-EATER: Travelers! You must be exhausted.
SCOUT: We've been at sea for days. We're only looking for supplies.
LOTUS-EATER: Then rest. There is no reason to hurry here.
The Lotus-Eater offers them a strange flower.
LOTUS-EATER: Eat. You'll feel better.
One scout hesitates before accepting the lotus.
SCOUT: What is it?
LOTUS-EATER: Something that will make you forget your troubles.
The scout eats the lotus.
The screen briefly blurs.
SCOUT: I... I feel wonderful.
SECOND SCOUT: What about the ships? Odysseus is waiting.
SCOUT: Odysseus? Why should we go back?
The second scout looks toward the beach before accepting a lotus himself.
[SCREEN FADES TO BLACK.]
The Missing Scouts
[CUTSCENE]
Several hours pass.
Odysseus stands beside his ship, watching the forest.
EURYLOCHUS: They should have returned by now.
ODYSSEUS: I know.
EURYLOCHUS: Perhaps they've found something worth staying for.
ODYSSEUS: Or something is keeping them there.
Odysseus grabs his sword.
ODYSSEUS: I'm going after them.
MAIN QUEST UPDATED: FIND THE MISSING SCOUTS
Objective 1: Enter the forest. Objective 2: Follow the scouts' footprints. Objective 3: Locate the missing crew members.
The player explores the forest, following footprints and investigating abandoned supplies.
Eventually, Odysseus discovers his men sitting among the Lotus-Eaters, eating lotus flowers.
ODYSSEUS: There you are! I've been looking everywhere for you.
SCOUT: Odysseus! Come, sit with us.
ODYSSEUS: We have to return to the ships.
SCOUT: Why?
ODYSSEUS: Because we're going home.
SCOUT: Home?
The scout looks confused.
SCOUT: I don't want to go home. I want to stay here.
Odysseus notices the flowers scattered around them.
ODYSSEUS: What have you been eating?
SCOUT: Try some. You'll understand.
The scout offers Odysseus a lotus.
Dialogue Choice:
A: "Put that down. We're leaving." B: "Don't you remember Ithaca?" C: "What has this flower done to you?"
Each choice produces different dialogue, but all lead Odysseus to discover that the lotus causes those who eat it to forget their desire to return home.
ODYSSEUS: You've forgotten your families. Your homes. Everything we've fought to return to.
SCOUT: None of that matters anymore.
ODYSSEUS: It matters to me.
MAIN QUEST UPDATED: ESCAPE THE LOTUS-EATERS

Objective 1: Retrieve all three scouts. Objective 2: Escort them back through the forest. Objective 3: Prevent the scouts from returning to the lotus fields. Objective 4: Secure the scouts aboard the ship.
Gameplay Mechanic — The Lotus Effect
During this section, the player must guide the affected crew members toward the ships.
The scouts periodically attempt to wander back toward the lotus fields, forcing the player to retrieve them.
SCOUT: Please! Just let me stay!
ODYSSEUS: You don't know what you're saying.
SCOUT: I'm happy here!
ODYSSEUS: And tomorrow you'll forget you ever had a home.
The player must reach the beach with all three scouts to complete the quest.
Departure Cutscene
Odysseus finally reaches the ships with the affected crew members.
They continue struggling to return to the island.
EURYLOCHUS: What's wrong with them?
ODYSSEUS: The flowers. They've made them forget why we're sailing.
EURYLOCHUS: They refuse to leave?
ODYSSEUS: Then we'll have to make sure they cannot return.
Odysseus orders the men to secure the affected scouts beneath the rowing benches until the ships have left the island.
SCOUT: Odysseus! Please!
Odysseus hesitates.
SCOUT: We don't want to leave!
ODYSSEUS: I know.
He turns toward the remaining crew.
ODYSSEUS: Everyone aboard. No one else goes ashore.
The sails rise.
As the ships pull away, the affected scouts continue calling out for the island.
Odysseus stands at the bow, watching the land disappear behind them.
EURYLOCHUS: They seemed happy.
ODYSSEUS: They'd forgotten everything that made them who they were.
EURYLOCHUS: Perhaps forgetting would be easier.
Odysseus looks toward the horizon.
ODYSSEUS: Perhaps. But I didn't survive Troy just to forget what I'm returning to.
QUEST COMPLETE: THE FORGOTTEN HOME
CREW LOST: 0
LESSON UNLOCKED: Temptation can be just as dangerous as an enemy, especially when it makes someone forget their purpose.
Transition to the Next Location
[CUTSCENE]
Several days later, the fleet approaches another unfamiliar coastline.
Towering cliffs rise above the water, and the entrance to a massive cave can be seen in the distance.
CREWMAN: Captain! Another island ahead!
EURYLOCHUS: Should we sail past it?
Odysseus studies the coastline.
ODYSSEUS: We need supplies. And I want to know who lives there.
The camera slowly moves toward the dark cave entrance.
A deep, distant sound echoes from within.
[SCREEN FADES TO BLACK.]
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: LAND OF THE CYCLOPES
NEW MAIN QUEST: THE ONE-EYED GIANT
Objective: Explore the mysterious island.

scenes.title: THE ISLAND OF THE CYCLOPES
objectives: Bring the supplies back to the ships.

side.name: A Quiet Evening
side.objective: Speak with two crew members beside the fire.

script: LOCATION 5 — THE ISLAND OF THE CYCLOPES
Arrival at the Island
[CUTSCENE]
The fleet reaches a quiet island. Goats wander over the hills, and smoke rises from caves across the channel.
CREWMAN: Goats. Finally, something we can eat.
ODYSSEUS: Bring the ships in. We need supplies.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE ONE-EYED GIANT
Objective 1: Explore the island.
Objective 2: Hunt goats and gather food.
Objective 3: Bring the supplies back to the ships.
The player explores the hills with the crew. Once the food is collected, the men make camp near the beach.
CREWMAN: There's smoke across the water.
ODYSSEUS: I see it. Someone lives over there.
Optional Side Quest — A Quiet Evening
Objective: Speak with two crew members beside the fire.
Two men sit eating, talking about home.
CREWMAN 1: I'd forgotten what a decent meal tastes like.
CREWMAN 2: We'll have plenty when we get back.
CREWMAN 1: When's that going to be?
Neither answers.
ODYSSEUS: Eat while it's hot. Get some sleep afterward.
Dialogue Choice:
A: "I'll get us home."
B: "I know you're tired of hearing promises."
C: "We'll see what tomorrow brings."
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: A QUIET EVENING
Across the Channel
[CUTSCENE]
The next morning, Odysseus chooses a small group to explore the opposite shore.
ODYSSEUS: The other ships stay here. We'll be back before dark.
CREWMAN: And if the people over there don't want visitors?
ODYSSEUS: Then we leave.
Odysseus loads a skin of strong wine onto the ship, a gift he received from Maron.
NEW ITEM: MARON'S WINE
ITEM DESCRIPTION: Strong wine. It may be useful later.
QUEST COMPLETE: THE ONE-EYED GIANT
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: POLYPHEMUS' CAVE
NEW MAIN QUEST: THE CAVE'S OWNER
CREW LOST: 0

scenes.title: POLYPHEMUS' CAVE
objectives: Examine the animal pens and food stores.
Search for clues about the owner.
Inspect the stone blocking the cave.

side.name: You Should Have Listened
side.objective: Speak to the crewman who wanted to leave.

script: LOCATION 6 — POLYPHEMUS' CAVE
The Empty Cave
[CUTSCENE]
Odysseus and twelve men reach a large cave filled with sheep, cheese, and enormous jars.
CREWMAN: Let's take what we can and get out.
ODYSSEUS: Not yet. I want to meet whoever lives here.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE CAVE'S OWNER
Objective 1: Explore the cave.
Objective 2: Examine the animal pens and food stores.
Objective 3: Search for clues about the owner.
The player finds tools far too large for a normal person to use.
[CUTSCENE]
Heavy footsteps approach. A giant with one eye enters the cave and blocks its entrance with a massive stone.
POLYPHEMUS: Who are you? What are you doing in my cave?
ODYSSEUS: We're Greeks trying to get home from Troy. We ask you to welcome us as guests.
POLYPHEMUS: You think I care what Zeus says about guests?
POLYPHEMUS: Where did you leave your ship?
Dialogue Choice:
A: "It was wrecked on the rocks."
B: "We lost it in the storm."
C: "There's no ship for you to find."
All three choices keep the ship's location secret.
Polyphemus seizes two of the men. The camera cuts to Odysseus and the others as they realize they are trapped.
CREW LOST: 2
MAIN QUEST UPDATED: FIND A WAY OUT
Objective 1: Inspect the stone blocking the cave.
Objective 2: Speak to the surviving men.
Objective 3: Find something that could help them escape.
CREWMAN: We said we should leave.
ODYSSEUS: I know.
CREWMAN: What do we do now?
ODYSSEUS: First we stay alive. Then we get out.
Optional Side Quest — You Should Have Listened
Objective: Speak to the crewman who wanted to leave.
Dialogue Choice:
A: "You were right."
B: "I thought he'd give us shelter."
C: "Arguing won't move that stone."
The conversation changes the crewman's reaction but does not change the story.
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: YOU SHOULD HAVE LISTENED
[CUTSCENE]
Over the next day, Polyphemus takes four more men. Odysseus waits for a chance to act.
CREW LOST: 6
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST UPDATED: THE ESCAPE PLAN
Objective 1: Locate the giant's wooden club.
Objective 2: Work with the crew to prepare a sharpened stake.
Objective 3: Wait until Polyphemus returns.
That evening, Odysseus offers Polyphemus the strong wine.
ODYSSEUS: Try this. We brought it from our ship.
POLYPHEMUS: That's good wine. What's your name?
ODYSSEUS: Nobody.
POLYPHEMUS: Nobody? Strange name.
The giant drinks more and falls asleep.
[CUTSCENE]
The crew carries out Odysseus' plan. Polyphemus wakes shouting and calls for the other Cyclopes.
OTHER CYCLOPS: Who's hurting you?
POLYPHEMUS: Nobody!
The other Cyclopes leave, thinking he needs no help.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST UPDATED: ESCAPE THE CAVE
Objective 1: Stay out of Polyphemus' reach.
Objective 2: Hide beneath the sheep as they are let outside.
Objective 3: Reach the ship with the surviving men.
Polyphemus feels the backs of the sheep, but the Greeks slip out underneath them.
[CUTSCENE]
Back on the ship, the crew rows as fast as it can.
CREWMAN: We made it! Don't say anything. Just go!
Odysseus turns toward the shore.
ODYSSEUS: Cyclops! Remember who beat you. Odysseus of Ithaca!
CREWMAN: Why would you tell him that?
POLYPHEMUS: Father Poseidon! Let Odysseus suffer on his way home!
The crew falls silent.
QUEST COMPLETE: ESCAPE THE CAVE
CREW LOST: 6
LESSON UNLOCKED: Odysseus' quick thinking saved his men, but his pride may cost them later.
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: AEOLIA
NEW MAIN QUEST: THE KEEPER OF THE WINDS

scenes.title: AEOLIA

side.name: An Empty Seat
side.objective: Speak with a crewman sitting alone by the harbor.

script: LOCATION 7 — AEOLIA
The Keeper of the Winds
[CUTSCENE]
The ships reach an island surrounded by bronze walls. Aeolus, keeper of the winds, invites the travelers into his palace.
AEOLUS: So you're the men who came all the way from Troy.
ODYSSEUS: We're trying to get back to Ithaca.
AEOLUS: Then sit. Tell me what happened.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE KEEPER OF THE WINDS
Objective 1: Explore the palace.
Objective 2: Speak with Aeolus.
Objective 3: Check on the crew.
Optional Side Quest — An Empty Seat
Objective: Speak with a crewman sitting alone by the harbor.
ODYSSEUS: Mind if I sit?
CREWMAN: He always sat right there. Every night since Troy.
Odysseus sits beside him.
Dialogue Choice:
A: "Tell me about him."
B: "I'm sorry we couldn't bring him back."
C: "I remember him too."
The scene gives the player more background about the men lost in the cave.
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: AN EMPTY SEAT
[CUTSCENE]
One month passes. The crew rests, repairs the ships, and listens to Odysseus tell Aeolus about the journey.
ODYSSEUS: You've done enough for us. We should leave.
AEOLUS: You'll need a good wind.
Aeolus hands Odysseus a tightly tied bag.
AEOLUS: Keep this shut. I've trapped the dangerous winds inside.
ODYSSEUS: And the one we need?
AEOLUS: I'll send it behind you.
NEW ITEM: BAG OF WINDS
ITEM DESCRIPTION: A sealed bag containing the winds that could blow the ships off course.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST UPDATED: PREPARE FOR HOME
Objective 1: Gather supplies.
Objective 2: Return to the ship.
Objective 3: Secure Aeolus' gift.
[CUTSCENE]
The fleet leaves Aeolia. For days, a steady wind carries them toward Ithaca.
CREWMAN: I can see land!
ODYSSEUS: That's Ithaca.
Odysseus, exhausted from steering, finally falls asleep. Two crewmen stare at the bag.
CREWMAN 1: He hasn't let anyone touch it.
CREWMAN 2: Think there's gold in there?
CREWMAN 1: Let's see.
They open it. The trapped winds rush out, and the ships are blown far from home.
ODYSSEUS: What have you done?
CREWMAN: We thought he gave you treasure!
ODYSSEUS: It was the wind. It was our way home.
MAIN QUEST UPDATED: A SECOND CHANCE
Objective 1: Keep the ship together.
Objective 2: Return to Aeolia.
[CUTSCENE]
Odysseus begs Aeolus for help again.
ODYSSEUS: We were almost home. Give us one more chance.
AEOLUS: I helped you once. If the gods keep sending you back, I won't go against them.
ODYSSEUS: So that's it?
AEOLUS: You need to leave my island.
The crew sails away without help.
QUEST COMPLETE: THE KEEPER OF THE WINDS
LESSON UNLOCKED: Even when home is close, distrust can undo everything.
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: TELEPYLOS
NEW MAIN QUEST: THE GIANTS' HARBOR

scenes.title: TELEPYLOS: LAND OF THE LAESTRYGONIANS
objectives: Find a way out if trouble starts.

side.name: Names on the Oars
side.objective: Ask a survivor about the ships that were lost.

script: LOCATION 8 — TELEPYLOS: LAND OF THE LAESTRYGONIANS
The Giants' Harbor
[CUTSCENE]
A narrow harbor opens between high cliffs. All the ships except Odysseus' sail inside. Odysseus ties his ship outside the entrance.
EURYLOCHUS: Why are we staying out here?
ODYSSEUS: I don't like how narrow that passage is.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE GIANTS' HARBOR
Objective 1: Send scouts into the city.
Objective 2: Watch for their return.
Objective 3: Find a way out if trouble starts.
The scouts meet a young woman at a spring. She points them toward the palace.
[CUTSCENE]
Inside, the king Antiphates turns on the visitors. One scout escapes to warn the ships.
CREWMAN: Captain! They're giants! We have to leave!
Boulders fall into the harbor, blocking the ships' escape. The men rush to get away while Odysseus cuts his own ship loose outside the entrance.
ODYSSEUS: Row! Don't look back!
The single surviving ship heads out to sea.
Optional Side Quest — Names on the Oars
Objective: Ask a survivor about the ships that were lost.
CREWMAN: My brother was on the second ship. He said he'd see me at supper.
ODYSSEUS: I wish I had something to tell you.
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: NAMES ON THE OARS
QUEST COMPLETE: THE GIANTS' HARBOR
FLEET REMAINING: 1 SHIP
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: AEAEA
NEW MAIN QUEST: THE WITCH'S ISLAND

scenes.title: AEAEA: CIRCE'S ISLAND
objectives: Follow the path to Circe's house.

side.name: The Other Side of the Story
side.objective: Ask Eurylochus why he stayed outside.

script: LOCATION 9 — AEAEA: CIRCE'S ISLAND
The House in the Woods
[CUTSCENE]
The surviving ship reaches a wooded island. From a hilltop, Odysseus sees smoke rising above the trees.
ODYSSEUS: We can't sail much farther without food. We'll search in two groups.
Eurylochus leads one group inland. Hours later, he returns alone.
EURYLOCHUS: There was a house. A woman invited us inside. I stayed out. The others never came back.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE WITCH'S ISLAND
Objective 1: Follow the path to Circe's house.
Objective 2: Find the missing crew.
Objective 3: Confront Circe.
On the path, Hermes stops Odysseus and gives him a protective herb.
HERMES: Take this. Whatever she offers you, don't trust it.
ODYSSEUS: And the men?
HERMES: Make her promise to put them right.
[CUTSCENE]
Odysseus finds the missing men transformed into pigs. Circe offers him a drink, but her magic fails.
CIRCE: How are you still standing?
ODYSSEUS: Turn my men back. Now.
Circe agrees and restores the crew.
CREWMAN: Captain? What happened to us?
ODYSSEUS: You're back. That's what matters.
Optional Side Quest — The Other Side of the Story
Objective: Ask Eurylochus why he stayed outside.
EURYLOCHUS: I thought I was being a coward. But I knew something was wrong.
Dialogue Choice:
A: "You warned me. That matters."
B: "Next time, bring everyone back."
C: "You did what you could."
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: THE OTHER SIDE OF THE STORY
Time Passes
[CUTSCENE]
The men rest on Aeaea. One month becomes many, and eventually a year has passed.
EURYLOCHUS: Are we ever leaving?
ODYSSEUS: Tomorrow. I'll speak to Circe.
CIRCE: If you want to get home, first you must go to the land of the dead and speak with Tiresias.
ODYSSEUS: The Underworld? You can't be serious.
CIRCE: I am. He knows the way you must take.
QUEST COMPLETE: THE WITCH'S ISLAND
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: THE LAND OF THE CIMMERIANS
NEW MAIN QUEST: THE ROAD BELOW

scenes.title: LAND OF THE CIMMERIANS
scenes.chapter: At the Edge of the World
objectives: Follow Circe's directions along the shore.
Find the entrance to the Underworld.
script: LOCATION 10 — LAND OF THE CIMMERIANS
At the Edge of the World
[CUTSCENE]
After a long voyage, the ship reaches a shore covered in mist. There is no sunrise here, only dim light and cold water.
CREWMAN: I can't see ten steps ahead.
ODYSSEUS: Stay close to the ship. We won't be long.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE ROAD BELOW
Objective 1: Follow Circe's directions along the shore.
Objective 2: Find the entrance to the Underworld.
Objective 3: Enter and seek Tiresias.
The player follows a path through the fog. At the end of it, the ground slopes into darkness.
CREWMAN: Tell me we're not going down there.
ODYSSEUS: I wish I could.
QUEST COMPLETE: THE ROAD BELOW
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: THE UNDERWORLD
NEW MAIN QUEST: THE PROPHET'S WARNING

scenes.title: THE UNDERWORLD

side.name: Familiar Faces
side.objective: Speak with three spirits before leaving.

script: LOCATION 11 — THE UNDERWORLD
The Prophet's Warning
[CUTSCENE]
Odysseus enters the shadowy realm. Figures gather around him, some familiar and others unknown.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE PROPHET'S WARNING
Objective 1: Find Tiresias.
Objective 2: Listen to his prophecy.
Objective 3: Return to the entrance.
TIRESIAS: You can still reach Ithaca. But listen closely. Do not harm the cattle of Helios.
ODYSSEUS: And if my men won't listen?
TIRESIAS: Then you may be the only one who makes it home.
ODYSSEUS: I need to know about my wife and son.
TIRESIAS: Go home. You'll find trouble waiting there as well.
Optional Side Quest — Familiar Faces
Objective: Speak with three spirits before leaving.
Odysseus may meet his mother Anticleia and the warriors Agamemnon and Achilles. Their stories reveal what happened after Troy and what the living leave behind.
ANTICLEIA: Your son is growing up. Penelope is still waiting.
ODYSSEUS: I should have been there.
ANTICLEIA: Then make it home while you can.
ACHILLES: You're still chasing stories about heroes?
ODYSSEUS: I'm just trying to get home.
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: FAMILIAR FACES
[CUTSCENE]
Odysseus returns to the ship, quieter than when he entered.
CREWMAN: What did he say?
ODYSSEUS: That we have to be careful. Especially when we're hungry.
QUEST COMPLETE: THE PROPHET'S WARNING
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: AEAEA
NEW MAIN QUEST: ONE LAST WARNING

scenes.title: RETURN TO AEAEA

side.name: A Proper Goodbye
side.objective: Speak with a crew member at Elpenor's grave.

script: LOCATION 12 — RETURN TO AEAEA
One Last Warning
[CUTSCENE]
Odysseus returns to Circe's island. The crew buries Elpenor, who died there before the journey to the Underworld.
ODYSSEUS: We should have noticed he was missing.
EURYLOCHUS: We have to remember him now.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: ONE LAST WARNING
Objective 1: Pay respects to Elpenor.
Objective 2: Speak with Circe.
Objective 3: Prepare the ship.
CIRCE: First you'll pass the Sirens. Their voices will make you forget everything except the song.
ODYSSEUS: How do we get past?
CIRCE: Your crew must not hear them. If you insist on listening, have them tie you to the mast.
CIRCE: Then comes a narrow strait. Scylla waits on one side, Charybdis on the other. You cannot fight both.
ODYSSEUS: You make this sound easy.
CIRCE: I'm telling you it's hard so you might survive it.
Optional Side Quest — A Proper Goodbye
Objective: Speak with a crew member at Elpenor's grave.
CREWMAN: We'd been here a year. I thought nothing could happen to us.
ODYSSEUS: We can't keep making that mistake.
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: A PROPER GOODBYE
QUEST COMPLETE: ONE LAST WARNING
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: THE SIRENS
NEW MAIN QUEST: THE SONG AT SEA

scenes.title: THE ISLAND OF THE SIRENS
objectives: Check that the crew is ready.
Have the crew secure Odysseus to the mast.
Keep the ship moving past the island.
script: LOCATION 13 — THE ISLAND OF THE SIRENS
The Song at Sea
[CUTSCENE]
The ship approaches a quiet stretch of water. Odysseus gives the crew wax for their ears and asks to be tied to the mast.
EURYLOCHUS: You're sure you want to hear it?
ODYSSEUS: I want to know what we're up against.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE SONG AT SEA
Objective 1: Check that the crew is ready.
Objective 2: Have the crew secure Odysseus to the mast.
Objective 3: Keep the ship moving past the island.
The Sirens' song carries across the water. Odysseus struggles against the ropes and orders the crew to release him, but they cannot hear.
ODYSSEUS: Untie me! I said untie me!
The crew continues rowing until the song fades.
[CUTSCENE]
Eurylochus removes the wax from his ears and loosens the ropes.
EURYLOCHUS: You were yelling the whole time.
ODYSSEUS: Good thing nobody listened.
QUEST COMPLETE: THE SONG AT SEA
CREW LOST: 0
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: THE STRAIT
NEW MAIN QUEST: BETWEEN TWO MONSTERS

scenes.title: SCYLLA AND CHARYBDIS

side.name: The Captain's Choice
side.objective: Speak with Eurylochus after the strait.

script: LOCATION 14 — SCYLLA AND CHARYBDIS
Between Two Monsters
[CUTSCENE]
A narrow channel lies ahead. Water churns beside one cliff, while a creature waits in the rocks above the other.
EURYLOCHUS: Which way?
ODYSSEUS: Away from the whirlpool. Keep us close to the cliffs.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: BETWEEN TWO MONSTERS
Objective 1: Steer through the narrow channel.
Objective 2: Keep the ship moving.
Objective 3: Reach open water.
The ship passes the rocks. Scylla attacks, and six men are lost before the ship escapes.
CREWMAN: Six of them. We couldn't do anything.
ODYSSEUS: I know.
CREWMAN: Did you know that would happen?
Odysseus does not answer.
Optional Side Quest — The Captain's Choice
Objective: Speak with Eurylochus after the strait.
EURYLOCHUS: You chose the cliffs.
Dialogue Choice:
A: "The whirlpool would have taken everyone."
B: "I didn't have a good choice."
C: "You can blame me. I already do."
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: THE CAPTAIN'S CHOICE
QUEST COMPLETE: BETWEEN TWO MONSTERS
CREW LOST: 6
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: THRINACIA
NEW MAIN QUEST: THE FORBIDDEN HERD

scenes.title: THRINACIA: THE CATTLE OF HELIOS
objectives: Search for food that does not belong to Helios.
Speak with the crew about the warning.
Wait for the weather to clear.

side.name: The Last Rations
side.objective: Check on three hungry crew members.

script: LOCATION 15 — THRINACIA: THE CATTLE OF HELIOS
The Forbidden Herd
[CUTSCENE]
The tired crew reaches an island where cattle graze peacefully. Odysseus remembers Tiresias' warning.
ODYSSEUS: We cannot touch those animals. They're sacred to Helios.
EURYLOCHUS: Then we need to leave before our food runs out.
A storm traps the ship on the island for days. Supplies get low.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE FORBIDDEN HERD
Objective 1: Search for food that does not belong to Helios.
Objective 2: Speak with the crew about the warning.
Objective 3: Wait for the weather to clear.
Optional Side Quest — The Last Rations
Objective: Check on three hungry crew members.
CREWMAN: How much longer can we live on scraps?
ODYSSEUS: I don't know. But I know what Tiresias said.
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: THE LAST RATIONS
[CUTSCENE]
While Odysseus sleeps, Eurylochus persuades the men to slaughter some of Helios' cattle.
Odysseus wakes to the smell of cooking.
ODYSSEUS: Tell me you didn't.
EURYLOCHUS: We were hungry. You can't ask men to starve beside food.
ODYSSEUS: I told you what would happen.
The storm finally breaks. The men sail away, but Zeus sends a violent storm that destroys the ship. Odysseus is the only survivor.
[SCREEN FADES TO BLACK.]
QUEST COMPLETE: THE FORBIDDEN HERD
CREW REMAINING: ODYSSEUS
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: OGYGIA
NEW MAIN QUEST: LEAVE CALYPSO'S ISLAND

scenes.title: OGYGIA: CALYPSO'S ISLAND

side.name: Seven Years
side.objective: Explore the shoreline and hear Odysseus reflect on his time there.

script: LOCATION 16 — OGYGIA: CALYPSO'S ISLAND
Seven Years Later
[CUTSCENE]
Odysseus has spent seven years on Calypso's island. Every day he looks toward the sea.
CALYPSO: You could stay here and stop worrying about Ithaca.
ODYSSEUS: It's my home. I still want to go back.
Hermes arrives with an order from Zeus: Calypso must let Odysseus leave.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: LEAVE CALYPSO'S ISLAND
Objective 1: Gather wood for a raft.
Objective 2: Collect fresh water and supplies.
Objective 3: Set sail.
Optional Side Quest — Seven Years
Objective: Explore the shoreline and hear Odysseus reflect on his time there.
ODYSSEUS: I can hardly remember the sound of Telemachus' voice.
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: SEVEN YEARS
[CUTSCENE]
Calypso watches Odysseus push the raft into the water.
CALYPSO: The sea won't make this easy.
ODYSSEUS: It never does.
A storm later breaks the raft apart, but Odysseus reaches land.
QUEST COMPLETE: LEAVE CALYPSO'S ISLAND
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: SCHERIA
NEW MAIN QUEST: THE STRANGERS' SHORE

scenes.title: SCHERIA: LAND OF THE PHAEACIANS
objectives: Tell the court what happened on the journey.

side.name: A Stranger's Welcome
side.objective: Speak with Nausicaa about Phaeacian hospitality.

script: LOCATION 17 — SCHERIA: LAND OF THE PHAEACIANS
The Strangers' Shore
[CUTSCENE]
Odysseus wakes on a beach and meets Nausicaa, daughter of the Phaeacian king.
NAUSICAA: You look like you've been at sea a long time.
ODYSSEUS: Longer than I care to count.
NAUSICAA: My father might be able to help. Come to the palace.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE STRANGERS' SHORE
Objective 1: Reach the palace.
Objective 2: Ask King Alcinous for passage.
Objective 3: Tell the court what happened on the journey.
At a feast, a singer tells the story of the Trojan War. Odysseus grows quiet.
ALCINOUS: You knew the men in that story, didn't you?
ODYSSEUS: I was one of them. I'm Odysseus.
The court listens as he recounts his travels.
Optional Side Quest — A Stranger's Welcome
Objective: Speak with Nausicaa about Phaeacian hospitality.
NAUSICAA: We don't usually find kings sleeping on our beach.
ODYSSEUS: It's been an unusual journey.
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: A STRANGER'S WELCOME
[CUTSCENE]
Alcinous promises a ship. The Phaeacians carry Odysseus home while he sleeps, leaving him on Ithaca's shore with gifts.
QUEST COMPLETE: THE STRANGERS' SHORE
NEW LOCATION UNLOCKED: ITHACA
NEW MAIN QUEST: THE KING RETURNS

scenes.title: ITHACA: THE KING RETURNS
objectives: Reach the palace without revealing your identity.

side.name: The Old Dog
side.objective: Stop beside Argos near the palace gate.

script: LOCATION 18 — ITHACA: THE KING RETURNS
The Shore at Last
[CUTSCENE]
Odysseus wakes on a familiar beach. At first he does not recognize it. Athena appears and tells him he is finally home.
ATHENA: Ithaca. You're here.
ODYSSEUS: Then why doesn't it feel like it?
ATHENA: Your house is full of men who think you'll never return. You'll need to be careful.
Athena disguises Odysseus as a beggar.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST: THE KING RETURNS
Objective 1: Find Eumaeus, the loyal swineherd.
Objective 2: Meet Telemachus in secret.
Objective 3: Reach the palace without revealing your identity.
At Eumaeus' hut, Telemachus arrives. Athena allows Odysseus to reveal himself.
TELEMACHUS: My father is dead.
ODYSSEUS: Look at me. Do you really think so?
Telemachus stares at him, then embraces his father.
TELEMACHUS: You took your time.
ODYSSEUS: I know.
Optional Side Quest — The Old Dog
Objective: Stop beside Argos near the palace gate.
Argos recognizes Odysseus even through the disguise. Odysseus pauses beside his old dog before continuing inside.
SIDE QUEST COMPLETE: THE OLD DOG
The Bow Contest
[CUTSCENE]
Inside the palace, Penelope announces a contest: whoever can string Odysseus' bow and shoot through twelve axe heads may marry her.
SUITOR: Nobody here can even bend it.
ODYSSEUS: May I try?
SUITOR: You? Don't make us laugh.
PLAYER CONTROL BEGINS — ODYSSEUS
MAIN QUEST UPDATED: THE BOW OF ITHACA
Objective 1: Enter the contest.
Objective 2: String the bow.
Objective 3: Complete the shot.
Odysseus strings the bow and makes the shot. Telemachus stands beside him as he reveals who he is.
ODYSSEUS: This is my house.
[CUTSCENE]
With Telemachus and his loyal servants, Odysseus defeats the suitors and takes back the palace.
Penelope faces the man claiming to be her husband but refuses to believe him without proof.
PENELOPE: Tell the servants to move our bed out of the room.
ODYSSEUS: Move it? I built that bed around a living olive tree. It can't be moved.
Penelope recognizes the detail only Odysseus would know.
PENELOPE: It really is you.
ODYSSEUS: I'm home.
FINAL QUEST COMPLETE: THE KING RETURNS
ENDING UNLOCKED: HOME AT LAST
TEXT ON SCREEN:
The journey is over. Ithaca is home again.
[FADE TO BLACK.]
THE END
